reason: A settings and orchestration plugin that packages agent personas, models, permissions, and plugin selections into named scenarios and hot-switches them through a configuration interface.

summaries.zh: 将人设、模型、权限和插件组合为可复用场景，并通过设置页一键切换代理配置。
summaries.en: Packages personas, models, permissions, and plugin selections into reusable scenarios that can be switched from a settings interface.

capabilities: Stores and switches named persona, model, reasoning, permission, and plugin configurations
Injects selected persona text into the system prompt
Writes selected model and permission settings for new sessions
Enables and disables installed third-party plugin entries
Provides a settings UI and an API route for plugin discovery
